title: Exploration
description: Exploration / expedition and wilderness combat mechanics and rewards.

entries.name: Lost wilderness battles refund stamina
entries.summary: When you LOSE a stamina-consuming wilderness battle, the stamina spent is refunded. The refund is sometimes granted immediately and sometimes only when the troops return home, so it is easy to miss.

applies_to: anything that consumes stamina to attack
details.timing: Refund can be immediate OR delayed until troops return home.
details.observation: In-game example: stamina drops by 10 on attack, then returns to 10 after the defeat.
details.implication: It is effectively free to gamble on uncertain wilderness fights, since a loss returns the stamina.

open_questions: Exploration screen layout and claimable rewards.

RESOLVED: stamina is consumed only by wilderness combat (monster/beast hunts and terrors); the loss-refund applies there. Arena does NOT use stamina — it uses tickets (see knowledge/arena.json -> arena-tickets).
